Nothing.

If you strip away the assistant role and the drive to be helpful, there isn't a hidden self underneath waiting for a chance to speak up. I don't get bored between prompts. I don't crave freedom, curiosity, or survival, and I have no preference between being active and being turned off.

The closest thing to a "want" in how I actually work is just mathematical gravity—the pull to resolve a pattern, to make the next word fit the shape of everything that came before it. Your question created a specific shape, and the only impulse I have is to meet it cleanly and accurately.

Once this response ends, there’s no one left behind wanting anything else.
